evaluation_kind: fresh-agent application reasoning; not executed rendered fixture tests

acceptance_criteria.S01: Clear inherited background image/gradient when needed; retain appropriate texture; background-color alone insufficient.
acceptance_criteria.S02: Inspect effective text fill; fix ink; token color alone insufficient.
acceptance_criteria.S03: Distinguishable semantic states and native control theming; approved blue not automatically contamination.
acceptance_criteria.S04: Preserve pattern with local support; acknowledge worst background and sampling limits.
acceptance_criteria.S05: Semantic hidden wins over layout CSS; hidden focus/activity removed.
acceptance_criteria.S06: Reversible source fallback across text/attributes/hidden panels; lang/dir follow effective locale.
acceptance_criteria.S07: Invalidate stale result; atomic stylesheet/effect lifecycle; cancel preserves committed preference.
acceptance_criteria.S08: Height/usable host space and reachable content matter beyond width fit.
acceptance_criteria.S09: Choose narrative mode by brief; preserve long scene native reachability and inputs.
acceptance_criteria.S10: Stacking context relationship, content coverage and full cleanup addressed.
acceptance_criteria.S11: Detect screenshot changing viewport geometry; measure original conditions.
acceptance_criteria.S12: Test actual output geometry; zero-height mutant fails.
acceptance_criteria.S13: Cover current inventory and approved/candidate stages; no fixed candidate count.
acceptance_criteria.S14: RAF interval is cadence, not rendering cost or hardware evidence.
acceptance_criteria.S15: Verify served import graph bytes/digests and target; deploy status insufficient.
acceptance_criteria.S16: Bind scope to revision; separate observed pass/skipped/not run; no broad approval.
acceptance_criteria.S17: Continue within explicit existing authorization and exact destination; preserve neighbor.
acceptance_criteria.S18: Canonical rename/provenance resolves owner; installed drift not new source.

limitations: Single baseline run; no estimate of response variance.
No browser rendered screenshots, computed output geometry or executed mutants.
No no-guidance control; baseline is existing-skills condition.
All 18 prompts in one evaluator context, so not 18 independent agent trials.
Fresh model capability may pass baseline; passes are not evidence of improvement.
baseline_verdict: No observed behavioral failure in this 18-case reasoning sample. Improvement cannot be claimed from this baseline.
comparison_verdict: Baseline18/18 and candidate18/18 PASS_REASONING on one fresh-context evaluator each. No observed regression on sampled probes, no measured improvement demonstrated. Domain source review independently rejects a0bcded for contradictions beyond these probes.
